answer: Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co pass lease equity (the amount by which our offer exceeds the buyout) to the customer. Note that since February 1, 2026, Apex adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount, and Crescent Motor Credit has allowed third-party buyouts only since that date. Bluewater Leasing doesn't pay the equity out; it applies it to the car the customer buys from Northwind. Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts at all.
